summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised: 10 backend suite tests (pre-existing, covering workflow/optimization/approval/trust/eval) + 2 new backend tests for CSV upload + 8 browser checks (one run twice, once on preview URL) all passing.

action_items.description: React 'change in the order of Hooks' console warning observed on DecisionStudio page during role-switch re-renders (decision-studio-role-gated-approval and optimization-classical-vs-quantum checks). Did not break functionality in any exercised flow, but is a real React anti-pattern worth a source review (likely a hook called conditionally/after an early return in DecisionStudio.tsx).

checks.evidence: Audit table filtered by 'dataset.loaded' and 'approval' action text both returned matching audit-action-* rows. Settings: capability-cards visible; as Executive settings-save-button enabled and save succeeded; as Analyst settings-save-button disabled; API cross-check PUT /api/settings as u-analyst-1 -> 403.
